author: NE Valley Times
title: Axon expands public safety ecosystem with new tech and partnerships
text:
Mark Stanton, President & CEO | Scottsdale Area Chamber of Commerce
Mark Stanton, President & CEO | Scottsdale Area Chamber of Commerce
Axon has announced an expansion of its real-time network and public safety ecosystem with new technologies, AI tools, and partnerships. The company introduced Axon Outpost and Axon Lightpost, two fixed intelligent ALPR cameras, to join the Axon Fleet 3. These devices aim to enhance vehicle recognition by capturing detailed attributes.
The company's partner ecosystem is expanding through a new Works With Axon certified partner program, connecting third-party cameras and creating an interoperable public safety network integrated via Axon Fusus. Additionally, the launch of Axon Assistant provides officers hands-free access to translation services and policy guidance.
A significant partnership with Ring allows customers to share video footage with law enforcement on their terms. Rick Smith, Founder & CEO of Axon, emphasized the importance of building tools that protect lives while fostering community collaboration.
Ring's integration enables secure sharing of video footage from Ring customers with investigators during active cases. Jamie Siminoff, Founder of Ring, highlighted how this collaboration connects communities with public safety agencies.
Further integrations include Citizen for enhanced communication in cities using the Axon Fusus platform and Auror for combating organized theft in retail spaces. These collaborations aim to create a smarter public safety system.
Axon's AI Era Plan introduces new AI-powered tools like Unlimited Smart Detection and Policy Chat. The plan also includes enhancements to Draft One, an AI report writer that reduces report writing time significantly.
Underpinning these advancements is Axon's commitment to Responsible Innovation, focusing on transparency and privacy in product development. Jeff Kunins, Chief Product & Technology Officer at Axon, stated that Responsible Innovation aims to make positive actions easier while hindering negative ones.
For more information about these announcements or specific product availability, contact an Axon representative or visit axon.com/newsroom.
